coverage.notes: This case focuses on drawer preferences and logout, not upstream navigation setup.

preconditions: The standard E2E user exists and can sign in.
The authenticated shell header is available after login.
The language and theme controls are visible in the settings drawer.
assertions: The user can open the settings drawer.
Language and theme changes are reflected in the drawer state.
Logout returns the browser to the login screen.
notes: Keeps preference switching and logout verification isolated from history and stats coverage.
